answer: The counter asks for Deputised cordwainer registry entry first, and an entry cordwainers keep after leather inspections is the answer it accepts. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Before the stamp comes a deposit of 68 credits, frozen until 13 days after the grading closes, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The clerk notes inlet. sparrow stays on the record. zenith is written on the receipt.
